=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:134,674-677 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE` was cut down to `\bunrunnable\b`, so a result such as `passed: could not verify (no token available)` or `passed: cannot run preflight without gh` now passes both regexes in `_semantic_errors`.
  WHY: `validate_result` and `check_diff` accept the registry-entry removal and the script deletion, and `run_apply` pushes them with GH_PAT into a maintenance PR; this reopens the fabricated-preflight path. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it BLOCKER and the others MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:140 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `PREFLIGHT_PASSED_RE = re.compile(r"\s*pass(?:ed)?\b", re.IGNORECASE)` accepts a bare `pass`, or any result that starts with "pass", with no evidence, although the prompt requires `passed: <evidence>`.
  WHY: An unbacked `pass` for a check that never ran flows through `validate_result` → `check_diff` → `run_apply`, and the deletion lands in the maintenance PR. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT, so the highest is used.
- tests/test_plan_autopilot.py:708-712 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new test explicitly asserts that a bare preflight result of `"pass"` (no colon, no evidence) passes `validate_result`.
  WHY: The test builds the regression into the contract, so a fabricated `{"check": "x", "result": "pass"}` passes validation and the deletion is pushed.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1194-1220 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The answer-preservation loop in `run_decisions` does not skip paths in `opened`, so for a re-asked plan it overwrites the fresh `asked_at` (collect time) with the old one and sets `comments=-1`.
  WHY: The next collect re-reads the old comments, and a stale trusted answer such as "Q1: A" is applied to a different, renumbered new Q1 and pushed into a maintenance PR. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it BLOCKER and the others MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1198-1220 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The decision close branch is gated on `if pr_number:`, so an answer applied with no file change (`pr_number == ""`) never closes the issue, and the preservation loop then sets `comments=-1` for that path.
  WHY: The `ai:plan-decision` issue stays open indefinitely, which violates Goal 7. It also stays under "Decisions pending", and every audit re-reads and re-applies the same answer at the cost of an extra comments listing. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 rated it BLOCKER and the others MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:502-517 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `run_collect` passes `"decision_answers": answers` (answer text only) and drops the question text from the decision issue body, so the model gets "Q1: A" without the question it refers to.
  WHY: The model has to re-derive the questions non-deterministically, so a mismatch applies option A of a different question to the plan; carrying answers across runs and re-asks makes this worse.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1220 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `asked_at=str(before.get("asked_at") or "")` stores an empty cutoff when the prior entry has no `asked_at`, so `trusted_answers` accepts every historical trusted comment.
  WHY: Because `comments=-1` forces a re-read, the full comment history keeps reaching the model, which widens the answer window the round-3 hardening was meant to close. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT and minimax_minimax-m3 MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1391-1394 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `decide_outcome` treats an empty classification result as `idle_all_done`.
  WHY: If the model auditor leaves valid plans out of the classification array, `open_work` becomes empty and the autopilot stops early, ignoring plans that should have been audited.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1070-1080 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `run_apply` creates the `ai:plan-autopilot` label and the status issue as a side effect. If a transient `gh` 5xx loses the POST reply, `state["gate"]["status_issue"]` is left `""`, and this first-run path lacks the `read_failed → save_marker=false` handling that later skips have.
  WHY: Later runs fall back to no `Refs #N` in the maintenance PR body and commits, and the report step creates a duplicate status issue on a later tick.
- agents.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md:apply description | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The fragment still says a removal whose preflight result says `unrunnable` or failed is refused, but the rule is now that the result must start with `passed` and must not contain `unrunnable`.
  WHY: Operators and future editors read the agents fragment as the contract, and it no longer matches `_semantic_errors` at line 676; this is documentation drift only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "It audits every plan under `docs/plans/`." (Summary; Goals 2 / Goal 10)
  expected_change_site: scripts/plan_autopilot.py `validate_result` / `_semantic_errors` (around line 660), or `finish_audit`, cross-checked against `list_plans(workdir)`; `decide_outcome` (around line 1391)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `validate_result` checks only the schema and semantics of each classification entry; no hunk compares `classification[].path` with the plan files in the checkout or with `list_plans(workdir)`; `decide_outcome` (lines 1391-1394) reports `idle_all_done` for an empty classification with no `needs_decision`, so an audit that omits existing plans is accepted as complete and the cache marker is saved
- requirement: "Each NEEDS DECISION plan gets exactly one open `ai:plan-decision` issue ... An answer is applied by a later audit only when it comes from an OWNER / MEMBER / COLLABORATOR comment. The issue is then closed (`state_reason: completed`) with a link to the PR that applied it." (Goal 7)
  expected_change_site: scripts/plan_autopilot.py run_decisions (close branch at line 1199) and run_collect (input bundle at line 512)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: no code path closes a decision whose answer was applied without a file change, and the input bundle gives the model no question text to map answers to
- requirement: "The prompt is the unattended form of `/audit-plans` steps 1–8"; step 5 ranks by impact/leverage, priority order, dependencies, unblocking value, blast radius, risk and effort, and produces a ranked candidate list
  expected_change_site: prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt (and prompts/_templates/mode-plan-audit.txt, prompts/contracts/mode-plan-audit.yml), step 6 / recommendation section and output contract
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: the prompt only refers to a "highest-ranked conflict-free candidate" (line 46) and never defines the ranking criteria from `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md:31–36`, the result schema has no ranked candidate list (`recommendation.plans` is an unordered set), and tests/test_plan_audit_prompt_contract.py does not pin the ranking criteria
- requirement: "Follow the existing per-role engine and model variable convention (`AI_ENGINE_<ROLE>`; agents.md 'Models in use')." (Implementation Step 3)
  expected_change_site: agents.d/10091-plan-autopilot.md, a `<!-- agents: section="Models in use (defaults; overridable via repo-vars)" -->` block for `PLAN_AUDIT`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: the fragment has only "Workflow architecture" and "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" blocks; the `PLAN_AUDIT` role (claude, claude-opus-5-5, profile write, `AI_ENGINE_PLAN_AUDIT`) is documented only in .github/ai/claude_engine.json and not in the model table at `agents.md:3129–3153`
- requirement: "Check the diff against the JSON result."
  expected_change_site: scripts/plan_autopilot.py `check_diff`, lines 923–943
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `check_diff` checks that each reported removal has a removed registry entry and a deletion, but never compares removed registry entries back against `result["removals"]`, so a registry entry can be removed with no reported removal or preflight evidence
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 134, PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE = re.compile(r"\bunrunnable\b", re.IGNORECASE); line 140, PREFLIGHT_PASSED_RE = re.compile(r"\s*pass(?:ed)?\b", re.IGNORECASE); line 676 in _semantic_errors | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Any result that starts with "pass" is accepted even when the rest says the check never ran (e.g. "passed: could not verify without a token", bare "pass", "Pass-through"); the could-not/cannot checks were dropped, and test_preflight_requires_an_explicit_pass_verdict accepts a bare "pass".
  WHY: The registry-entry removal and the script deletion pass validate_result and check_diff, and run_apply pushes them with GH_PAT into an auto-mergeable maintenance PR. Suggested fix: require evidence (`\s*passed?\s*:\s*\S`) and restore the could-not/cannot/unable-to phrases.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:lines 1194 and 1217-1220 in run_decisions | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The answer-preservation loop does not skip paths in `opened`, so re-asked plans get the old asked_at back and comments=-1.
  WHY: The stale "Q1: A" is fed to the model for the new Q1 and the edit goes into a maintenance PR. Fix: add `and path not in opened`.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 1199, `if pr_number:` (close branch), with lines 1217-1220 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A decision applied without a file change returns pr_number "", so the close branch is skipped and the path is stored with comments=-1 and the old asked_at.
  WHY: The answer is re-read and re-applied on every run, and the ai:plan-decision issue never closes (Goal 7) and stays under "Decisions pending".
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:lines 502-517 in run_collect | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: decision_answers holds only the answer text; the questions in the issue body are thrown away.
  WHY: The model cannot reliably map "Q1: A" to the right question, so a mismatched derivation applies the wrong option. Fix: include the "## Questions" section (about 3 lines, no extra API call).
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 1220, `asked_at=str(before.get("asked_at") or "")` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A missing prior asked_at stores "", so every past trusted comment counts as an answer.
  WHY: A lost state-marker entry feeds all historical comments to the model forever. Fix: fall back to known[path].get("asked_at").
